item.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp
item.description: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp on August 21, 2026 as an experimental image-input variant of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the sparse mixture-of-experts model with 284 billion total parameters and 13 billion active per token. It matches the text-only V4-Flash on agentic and reasoning tasks while adding image understanding, aimed at document and chart reading, visual question answering, and agent workflows that mix text and images. Images can be passed as inline base64 data, URLs, or through DeepSeek’s Files API, and the model tokenizes each image at 384 tokens, well below what GPT and Claude models typically use per image.
